verdict.rationale: Formant documents its own onboarding path for a robot. You install its agent via Docker on ROS1/ROS2 devices, configure data streams and export the device config as YAML or a template, and get first motion through peer-to-peer teleoperation or a ROS-topic publish command. It also claims to 'connect to multiple robot types with minimal lift.' However, it does not provide hardware drivers or low-level bring-up, and the 'hours rather than weeks' timeline is only a marketing implication. missing for 10: hardware driver bring-up support, evidence of time-to-first-motion, independent or hands-on corroboration of fast onboarding.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can bring up a new robot — drivers, configuration, first motion — in hours rather than weeks
